title: Pilates Session Reps Completed Leaderboard
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pilates:session reps_completed=*
| stats sum(reps_completed) as total_value, avg(reps_completed) as avg_value by studio_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks studio values by total and average reps completed across Pilates session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `reps_completed` values for each Pilates session event and review total and average reps completed by studio.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total reps completed.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which studio shows the biggest reps completed numbers in your Pilates session data.
